"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden will sign the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act will fully secure the right to vote in every state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act will ensure fair congressional maps for every American.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act will modernize and secure elections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act will curtail the corrupting influence of money in politics.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Too much money flows in the shadows to influence elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Advocacy groups can run ads on issues attacking or supporting a candidate right until Election Day without disclosing who's paying for that ad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Powerful special interests use front groups to run ads to win at any cost.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Foreign entities that aren't allowed to contribute to political campaigns use dark money loopholes to try to influence elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has called for immediate passage of the DISCLOSE Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The DISCLOSE Act will require advocacy groups that run ads to influence elections to disclose donors who contribute more than $10,000.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The DISCLOSE Act will ban foreign entities from contributing to advocacy groups.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Under President Biden's leadership, the FEC has finalized a rule expanding political advertising disclaimer requirements for online public communications.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
